chapter_summary: Gu Suizhou navigates his complex dynamic with Shen Feizhi, who maintains a facade of an ascetic, studious intellectual. Gu Suizhou enlists his associates, Xu Zhong and Leapton, to handle domestic tasks while he focuses on surveillance of the Shen family mansion. The chapter reveals Gu Suizhou's hidden vulnerability—a broken wooden fox carving linked to a past trauma involving Lin Sui—and discloses that Gu Suizhou suffers from a rare, memory-wiping mental illness, for which he requires medication.

new_characters.name: Leapton
new_characters.description: Works for Gu Suizhou; assists with tasks and is tasked with cooking for Shen Feizhi.
